Expand each product.

(u+4)(u-1) = u² - u + 4u - 4 = u² + 3u - 4

(u-3)(u+6) = u² + 6u - 3u - 18 = u² + 3u - 18

Subtracting: (u² + 3u - 4) - (u² + 3u - 18) = -4 + 18 = 14

Solution A reaches 14, which is correct. Solution B made an error when combining like terms: it computed -u + 4u - 3u as -4u, but it equals 0.

WINNER: A
